stemMd: A machine has value $V(t)=9600-750t$ dollars after $t$ years. Which interpretation of 750 is correct?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The value decreases by 750 dollars for each additional year.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The machine reaches zero value after 750 years.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The value decreases by 750 percent each year.

explanationMd: The coefficient of t is −750, measured in dollars per year. It describes a constant annual decrease, while 9600 is the initial value.

distractorRationale.d: The model is an absolute linear change, not a percentage multiplier.
distractorRationale.c: The coefficient is a rate, not a time.
